headline: Aeris Files Extrajudicial Reorganization to Restructure R$1.52B Debt
summary: Aeris has filed for an extrajudicial reorganization in São Paulo to restructure R$1.52 billion in debt, following board approval pending shareholder ratification.
why: Debt restructuring filings by capital-intensive manufacturers highlight credit distress and liquidity challenges in the renewable energy supply chain.

impacts.name: Aeris
impacts.why: Filing for debt restructuring indicates severe liquidity pressure affecting the company's equity value.
